questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign tells you to slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you to watch for pedestrians, especially children, and be ready to stop. Always let pedestrians cross safely at intersections and crosswalks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is approaching from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: The right lane will end soon. Move to the left lane before it closes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet. Drive more carefully and reduce your speed in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: The road ahead makes a sharp turn. Slow down before the turn, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black symbols. This sign alerts you that wet pavement makes the road slippery and harder to control. Drive carefully when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that traffic is moving in both directions on the road ahead. Be careful and stay in your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Check that it is safe, then proceed. Always let vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon combine into one lane. Be ready to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Let pedestrians and vehicles in the intersection or on the crossroad go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: One-way traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive on this street. Traffic flows in only one direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Playground nearby.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children who may be on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest legal speed allowed on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, drive slower than the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T-shaped intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points downward, they are signaling that they will stop. If you are following this driver, adjust your speed and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane leaves the highway. If you stay in this lane, you will exit. To continue on the highway, change lanes now.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown, which is 35 mph in this case.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Detour signs are orange with black letters. They tell you to take an alternate route because the main road is blocked by construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: A divided highway begins.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that ahead the road splits into two separate directions. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. A road will join from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: One-way traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive on a one-way street. It is a regulation sign that shows rules you must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that road conditions have changed because of work ahead. Follow the detour route shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. This sign points left, so the road curves sharply left. There may be several signs placed along the curve.
